sections.title: Lead-in — the weather and the seasons

exercises.instructionEn: In which card is the weather ...?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OB-HAVO.

Sarlavha: 'Come Rain or Shine'
  so'zma-so'z: yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
  ma'nosi: har qanday sharoitda, nima bo'lsa ham
  o'zbekchada: 'Qanday bo'lmasin', 'Har holatda ham'

TO'RT KARTA:
  A — gullagan daraxt, pushti ko'ylakdagi ayol, yigit gul uzyapti
  B — qor, yalang'och daraxtlar, qorbo'ron o'ynayotgan bolalar
  C — plyaj, katta to'q sariq soyabon, cho'milish kiyimidagi odam
  D — kuchli shamol, yalang'och daraxtlar, ko'l bo'yida ketayotgan
      paltodagi odamlar

OB-HAVO SIFATLARI:
  cold ......... sovuq
  cloudy ....... bulutli
  windy ........ shamolli
  freezing cold  qattiq sovuq (muzlatadigan)
  snowy ........ qorli
  hot .......... issiq
  sunny ........ quyoshli
  warm ......... iliq

tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan, odamlar shlyapasini ushlab turibdi.
Osmon bulutli va kulrang — kuz ob-havosi.

B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan, bolalar qorbo'ron o'ynayapti.
'freezing' = muzlatadigan — 'very cold' dan kuchliroq.

C kartada plyaj, quyoshdan saqlanish uchun katta soyabon,
odamlar cho'milish kiyimida — demak JUDA ISSIQ.

A kartada daraxtlar gullagan, o't yashil, osmon ochiq.
Issiq emas — ILIQ (bahor).

exercises.instructionEn: Label the cards with the names of the seasons: summer, winter, spring or autumn.
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarni fasl nomlari bilan belgilang: summer, winter, spring yoki autumn.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT FASL:
  spring ..... bahor  (mart, aprel, may)
  summer ..... yoz    (iyun, iyul, avgust)
  autumn ..... kuz    (sentabr, oktabr, noyabr)
              amerikacha: fall
  winter ..... qish   (dekabr, yanvar, fevral)

DIQQAT — FASL OLDIDA PREDLOG:
  IN spring, IN summer, IN autumn, IN winter
  Artikl kerak emas: 'in THE spring' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  kitob artiklsiz shaklni beradi.

tasks.prompt: Card A — trees full of white blossom, green grass, a young man picking blossom
tasks.promptUz: A karta: oq gullarga to'lgan daraxtlar, yashil o't, gul uzayotgan yigit
tasks.speak: Card A — trees full of white blossom, green grass, a young man picking blossom

tasks.prompt: Card B — deep snow everywhere, bare black trees, children in warm clothes throwing snowballs
tasks.promptUz: B karta: hamma yerda qalin qor, yalang'och qora daraxtlar, issiq kiyimdagi bolalar qorbo'ron o'ynayapti
tasks.speak: Card B — deep snow everywhere, bare black trees, children in warm clothes throwing snowballs

tasks.prompt: Card C — a beach, a big orange sunshade, a man in a swimming-costume on the sand
tasks.promptUz: C karta: plyaj, katta to'q sariq soyabon, qumda cho'milish kiyimidagi odam
tasks.speak: Card C — a beach, a big orange sunshade, a man in a swimming-costume on the sand

tasks.prompt: Card D — bare thin trees bending in the wind, fallen leaves, people in heavy coats by a lake
tasks.promptUz: D karta: shamolda egilgan ingichka yalang'och daraxtlar, to'kilgan barglar, ko'l bo'yida qalin paltodagi odamlar
tasks.speak: Card D — bare thin trees bending in the wind, fallen leaves, people in heavy coats by a lake

exercises.instructionEn: Then, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What's the weather like in spring?
  S2: It's warm and sunny in spring.

DIQQAT — 'What's the weather LIKE?':
  Bu ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol.
  'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS — 'qanday?' degani.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Ob-havo nimaga o'xshaydi?'

JAVOB DOIM 'IT'S ...' bilan boshlanadi:
  It's warm.  It's raining.  It's cold and windy.
  DIQQAT: 'The weather is warm' ham to'g'ri, lekin
  'IT'S ...' tabiiyroq.

tasks.en: S1: What's the weather like in spring?
S2: It's warm and sunny in spring.
S1: What's the weather like in summer?
S2: It's hot and sunny in summer.
S1: What's the weather like in autumn?
S2: It's cold, cloudy and windy in autumn.
tasks.uz: Kuzda sovuq, bulutli va shamolli bo'ladi.

tasks.en: S1: What's the weather like in winter?
S2: It's freezing cold and snowy in winter.
tasks.uz: Qishda qattiq sovuq va qorli bo'ladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match these sentences to the cards. Two of them do not match any of the cards.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni kartalarga moslang. Ulardan ikkitasi hech qaysi kartaga mos kelmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — IKKI GAP HECH QAYSI KARTAGA MOS KELMAYDI.
Kartalarda YOMG'IR ham, TUMAN ham yo'q.

OB-HAVO — IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1) FE'L bilan (hozir sodir bo'layotgan hodisa):
       It is raining.   — yomg'ir yog'yapti
       It is snowing.   — qor yog'yapti
       The sun is shining. — quyosh charaqlayapti
       The wind is blowing. — shamol esayapti

  2) SIFAT bilan ('be' + sifat):
       It's rainy.   — yomg'irli
       It's snowy.   — qorli
       It's sunny.   — quyoshli
       It's windy.   — shamolli
       It's cloudy.  — bulutli
       It's foggy.   — tumanli

Sifatlar OT + -Y qoidasi bilan yasalgan:
  rain → rainy,  snow → snowy,  sun → sunny,
  wind → windy,  cloud → cloudy,  fog → foggy

tasks.prompt: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.
tasks.promptUz: Shamolda egilgan daraxtlar bor kartani toping
tasks.whyUz:
D kartada daraxtlar shamoldan egilgan va osmon bulutli.
'a cloud' = bulut; 'to blow' = esmoq.
tasks.speak: 1  There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing. It's cloudy and windy.

tasks.prompt: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.
tasks.whyUz:
A karta (bahor) ham, C karta (yoz) ham quyoshli.
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri javob.
'to shine' = charaqlamoq, porlamoq.
tasks.speak: 2  The sun is shining. It's sunny.

tasks.prompt: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham yomg'ir yo'q.
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan biri.
tasks.speak: 3  It is raining. It's a rainy day.

tasks.prompt: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.
tasks.whyUz: B kartada hamma yer qor bilan qoplangan.
tasks.speak: 4  It is snowing. It's a snowy day.

tasks.prompt: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.
tasks.whyUz:
HECH QAYSI kartaga mos kelmaydi — birortasida ham tuman yo'q.
'fog' = tuman (sanalmaydigan ot).
Bu — kitob aytgan ikki gapdan ikkinchisi.
tasks.speak: 5  There is a lot of fog. It's foggy.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the cards. Which card shows someone who is wearing: 1 a red coat? 2 gloves? 3 boots? 4 a pink dress? 5 a heavy jacket? 6 a blue hat? 7 a swimming-costume? 8 a jacket and a red tie? 9 a black cap?
exercises.instructionUz: Kartalarga qarang. Qaysi kartada kimdir quyidagini kiygan: 1 qizil palto? 2 qo'lqop? 3 etik? 4 pushti ko'ylak? 5 qalin kurtka? 6 ko'k shlyapa? 7 cho'milish kiyimi? 8 pidjak va qizil galstuk? 9 qora kepka?
exercises.explanationUz:
KIYIM SO'ZLARI:
  a coat ............. palto
  gloves ............. qo'lqoplar (doim ko'plikda)
  boots .............. etiklar (doim ko'plikda)
  a dress ............ ko'ylak (ayollar uchun)
  a jacket ........... kurtka, pidjak
  a hat .............. shlyapa
  a swimming-costume . cho'milish kiyimi
  a tie .............. galstuk
  a cap .............. kepka (kozirekli bosh kiyim)

DIQQAT — 'to wear' fe'li:
  Hozir kiyib turgan bo'lsa: someone IS WEARING ...
  'to wear' = kiyib yurmoq (holat)
  'to put on' = kiyib olmoq (harakat)

tasks.whyUz:
B kartada chapdagi kichkina qiz QIZIL palto kiygan.
DIQQAT: D kartadagi ayolning paltosi PUSHTI (pink), qizil emas.
tasks.speak: 1  a red coat?

tasks.whyUz:
B kartadagi qizning qo'lida oq qo'lqop bor.
'gloves' DOIM ko'plikda — ikkita qo'l uchun.
tasks.speak: 2  gloves?

tasks.whyUz:
B kartadagi katta bolada qizil bog'ichli etiklar bor.
DIQQAT: A kartada ham etik bor, lekin B da qish etiklari aniqroq ko'rinadi.
tasks.speak: 3  boots?

tasks.whyUz:
A kartadagi ayol uzun PUSHTI ko'ylak kiygan.
'a dress' — faqat ayollar kiyimi.
tasks.speak: 4  a pink dress?

tasks.whyUz:
D kartadagi yigit qalin, mo'ynali qora kurtka kiygan.
'heavy' bu yerda = qalin, issiq (og'ir emas).
DIQQAT: B kartadagi bolaning kurtkasi ham qalin.
tasks.speak: 5  a heavy jacket?

tasks.whyUz: B kartadagi qizil paltodagi qiz KO'K shlyapa kiygan.
tasks.speak: 6  a blue hat?

tasks.whyUz:
C kartada qumda o'tirgan odam qizil cho'milish kiyimida.
'a swimming-costume' — britancha; amerikacha 'a swimsuit'.
tasks.speak: 7  a swimming-costume?

tasks.prompt: 8  a jacket and a red tie?
tasks.whyUz: A kartadagi yigit to'q rangli pidjak va QIZIL galstuk kiygan.
tasks.speak: 8  a jacket and a red tie?

tasks.promptUz: Shamolda bosh kiyimini ushlab turgan yigit
tasks.whyUz:
D kartadagi yigitda qora kepka bor — shamol uni uchirib yubormasin deb ushlab turibdi.
DIQQAT: A kartadagi yigitning kepkasi KATAKLI (checked), qora emas.
tasks.speak: 9  a black cap?

exercises.instructionEn: Match the cards to the sentences below.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu gaplarning hammasi PRESENT CONTINUOUS zamonida:
  ega + am/is/ARE + fe'l-ING

Bu zamon HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi —
rasmdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun eng mos zaman.

  They ARE SITTING ...  — o'tirishibdi
  They ARE THROWING ... — otishayapti
  They ARE PICKING ...  — terishayapti
  They ARE WALKING ...  — ketishayapti

tasks.left: 1  They are sitting on the beach under a sunshade.
4  They are walking by the lake.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the weather to the places.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH SHAHAR:
  Sydney — Avstraliya, JANUBIY yarim shar, issiq iqlim
  London — Angliya, yomg'ir va shamol bilan mashhur
  Warsaw — Polsha poytaxti, qishi qattiq sovuq va qorli

DIQQAT: 'heavily' = qattiq, kuchli (ravish).
  It is snowing HEAVILY. — Qor QALIN yog'yapti.
exercises.audioNoteUz: Rasmiy javob kassetada. Quyidagi moslik uch shaharning iqlimi bo'yicha aniq — har biriga sabab keltirilgan.

tasks.left: 2  It's very hot and the sun is shining.
3  It's windy today and it is raining.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard A (from Tom in Warsaw).
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA (a postcard) TUZILISHI:

  1) Murojaat:     Dear Sally,
  2) Salomlashish: A Happy New Year to all of you.
  3) Asosiy qism:  ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot
  4) Yakun:        Hope to see you soon.
  5) Xayrlashuv:   Best wishes,
  6) Imzo:         Tom

MANZIL (o'ng tomonda):
  Sally Jones          — ism
  12 Swan St           — ko'cha va uy raqami
  London SW1 4GB       — shahar va pochta indeksi
  England              — mamlakat

DIQQAT: inglizcha manzil KICHIKDAN KATTAGA yoziladi
(ism → ko'cha → shahar → mamlakat).

tasks.en: Dear Sally,
tasks.note:
'Dear + ism' — xat va otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
O'zbekchadagidek 'Assalomu alaykum' emas.

tasks.en: A Happy New Year to all of you.
tasks.note:
'A Happy New Year to you' — tabrik shakli.
'all of you' = hammangiz.

tasks.en: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
tasks.uz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysiz!
tasks.note:
'to imagine' = tasavvur qilmoq.
'how cold it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib O'ZGARMAYDI:
'how cold IS it' XATO.

tasks.en: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
tasks.uz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar issiq turish uchun qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun (sabab-natija).
'to keep them warm' — 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

tasks.en: They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.
tasks.note:
'a snowman' = qorbobo (snow + man).
'at the moment' = ayni paytda — Present Continuous belgisi.

tasks.en: Hope to see you soon.
tasks.note: '(I) hope to see you soon' — ega tushirilgan, otkritkada odatiy.

tasks.en: Best wishes, Tom
tasks.note: 'Best wishes' — do'st va tanishlarga yoziladigan xayrlashuv.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard B (from Tracy in London).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mr & Mrs Johnson   — janob va xonim Jonson
  2 Via Torino       — ko'cha (italyancha nom)
  Rome               — Rim
  Italy              — Italiya

Demak, Treysi Londondan Rimdagi ota-onasiga yozyapti.

DIQQAT: 'Mr' (janob) va 'Mrs' (turmush qurgan xonim) —
dan keyin nuqta qo'yilmaydi (britancha).

tasks.en: Dear Mum and Dad,
tasks.note: Ota-onaga murojaat. Britanchada 'Mum', amerikachada 'Mom'.

tasks.en: Greetings from London.
tasks.note:
'Greetings from ...' — otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
'a greeting' = salom, tabrik.

tasks.en: It's windy today and it is raining.
tasks.note: Ikki usul birga: SIFAT ('windy') va FE'L ('is raining').

tasks.en: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda (shim + ko'ylak).
'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment.
tasks.uz: Ular juda xursand, chunki hozir Rojdestvo archasini bezashayapti.
tasks.note:
'as' bu yerda = 'because' (chunki).
'to decorate' = bezamoq.
'the Christmas tree' = Rojdestvo archasi (yangi yil archasi).

tasks.en: We miss you a lot.
tasks.note:
'to miss somebody' = sog'inmoq.
'a lot' = juda ko'p (gap oxirida).

tasks.en: Love, Tracy
tasks.note:
'Love' — YAQIN kishilarga (oila, do'st) yoziladigan xayrlashuv.
Rasmiy xatda ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard C (from Pamela in Sydney).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mrs Bessie Bates   — Bessi Beyts xonim
  27 Park Lane       — ko'cha
  London SW3 9RY     — shahar va indeks
  England            — mamlakat

QIZIQ FAKT — UCHALA OTKRITKA HAM YANGI YIL PAYTIDA YOZILGAN:
  Tom (Varshava)  — 'A Happy New Year'  → QOR
  Tracy (London)  — 'Christmas tree'    → YOMG'IR
  Pamela (Sidney) — 'Season's greetings' → PLYAJ, ISSIQ

SABABI: Avstraliya JANUBIY yarim sharda joylashgan —
u yerda dekabr YOZ oyi! Fasllar teskari bo'ladi.

tasks.en: Dear Aunt Bessie,
tasks.note: 'Aunt' = xola, amma, ammaki. Ism oldida BOSH harf bilan.

tasks.en: Season's greetings from Sydney.
tasks.note:
'Season's greetings' — Rojdestvo va Yangi yil tabrigi.
So'zma-so'z: 'faslning salomlari'.

tasks.en: The weather is fantastic today and we are on the beach.
tasks.uz: Bugun ob-havo ajoyib va biz plyajdamiz.
tasks.note:
'fantastic' = ajoyib, zo'r.
'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida → ON.

tasks.en: It's very hot and the sun is shining, so we are all in our swimming costumes.
tasks.uz: Juda issiq va quyosh charaqlayapti, shuning uchun hammamiz cho'milish kiyimidamiz.
tasks.note:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun.
'we are all' = hammamiz (all egadan KEYIN).

tasks.en: Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle.
tasks.uz: Oyim, dadam, Sheyla va Frenk qumdan qal'a yasashayapti.
tasks.note:
'a sandcastle' = qum qal'a (sand + castle).
Sanashda oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.

tasks.en: There are a lot of people on the beach today.
tasks.uz: Bugun plyajda juda ko'p odam bor.
tasks.note:
'people' — ko'plik ot → ARE.
'a lot of' = juda ko'p.

tasks.en: Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
tasks.uz: Hamma suzyapti va yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanayapti.
tasks.note:
'everyone' — shakli birlik → IS ('everyone are' XATO).
'to enjoy' = zavqlanmoq, huzur qilmoq.

tasks.en: Come and see us soon!
tasks.note:
Buyruq gap — taklif ma'nosida.
'come and + fe'l' = kelib ...moq.

tasks.en: Lots of love, Pamela
tasks.note: 'Lots of love' — 'Love' ning kuchliroq shakli, oila a'zolariga.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the sentences which describe the people's clothes in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir rasmda odamlarning kiyimini tasvirlaydigan gaplar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir otkritkada KIYIM haqida BITTA gap bor.
Shu gaplarni topish kerak.

KIYIM HAQIDA GAPIRISHNING IKKI USULI:
  1) to WEAR + kiyim:  They are wearing heavy jackets.
  2) to BE IN + kiyim: They are in their pyjamas.
  Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noda.

tasks.answer: The children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
tasks.whyUz: Qorli va sovuq ob-havoga mos kiyim: qalin kurtka va qo'lqop.

tasks.answer: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
tasks.whyUz:
Uy ichida bo'lgani uchun pijamada.
'be IN + kiyim' — 'wear' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

tasks.answer: We are all in our swimming costumes.
tasks.whyUz: Issiq va plyajda bo'lgani uchun cho'milish kiyimida.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni otkritkalardan toping.
2, 3, 4-savollar 'What are ... doing?' shaklida —
demak javob ham Present Continuous bo'ladi.

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in Warsaw?
tasks.answer: It is very cold and it is snowing heavily.
tasks.whyUz: Tom: 'You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw! It is snowing heavily today.'
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in Warsaw?

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in London?
tasks.answer: It's windy and it is raining.
tasks.whyUz: Treysi: 'It's windy today and it is raining.'
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in London?

tasks.prompt: 1  What is the weather like in Sydney?
tasks.answer: It's very hot and the sun is shining.
tasks.whyUz:
Pamela: 'It's very hot and the sun is shining.'
Ob-havo 'fantastic' (ajoyib) deb ham baholangan.
tasks.speak: 1  What is the weather like in Sydney?

tasks.answer: They are making a snowman in the park.
tasks.promptUz: A otkritka, qor bilan nima qilinadi?
tasks.whyUz: Tom: 'They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.'
tasks.speak: 2  What are Tom's children doing?

tasks.answer: They are decorating the Christmas tree.
tasks.whyUz: Treysi: 'they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment'.
tasks.speak: 3  What are Tracy's children doing?

tasks.answer: They are making a sandcastle. Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
tasks.whyUz:
Pamela: 'Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle' va
'Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.'
tasks.speak: 4  What are Pamela's family doing?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the postcards again and make notes about each under these headings: city — weather — clothes — activities. Then, look at your notes and talk about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Otkritkalarni qayta o'qing va har biri haqida quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd yozing: shahar — ob-havo — kiyim — mashg'ulot. So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab har bir odam haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing ...'

TO'RT SARLAVHA:
  city ....... shahar
  weather .... ob-havo
  clothes .... kiyim
  activities . mashg'ulotlar

QAYD YOZISH USULI: to'liq gap emas, faqat KALIT so'zlar.
  Tom — Warsaw — very cold, snowing heavily —
        heavy jackets, gloves — making a snowman

tasks.whyUz: 'Greetings from ...' o'rniga Tom 'how cold it is in Warsaw' deydi.
'how cold it is' + 'It is snowing heavily today'.
'the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves'.

tasks.answer: making a snowman in the park
tasks.whyUz: 'They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.'
'Greetings from London.'
'It's windy today and it is raining.'
'The children are in their pyjamas.'
'they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment'.
'Season's greetings from Sydney.'
'The weather is fantastic today' + 'It's very hot and the sun is shining'.
'we are all in our swimming costumes'.

'Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle' +
'Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather'.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, look at your notes and talk about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab har bir odam haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing ...'

QOLIP:
  Ism + IS IN + shahar.
  It's + ob-havo + THERE.
  He/She/They + ARE WEARING / ARE IN + kiyim.
  They + ARE + mashg'ulot-ING.

'there' = u yerda — shaharni qayta aytmaslik uchun.

tasks.en: Tom haqida: Tom is in Warsaw.
Tom haqida: It's very cold there and it is snowing heavily.
tasks.uz: U yerda juda sovuq va qor qalin yog'yapti.

tasks.en: Tom haqida: His children are wearing heavy jackets and gloves.
tasks.uz: Uning bolalari qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.

tasks.en: Tom haqida: They are making a snowman in the park.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ob-havo otiga -y qo'shilib sifat yasaladi. Ba'zilarida oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ob-havo hodisasi -ING bilan aytiladi.
Fasl nomlari kichik harf bilan, oy nomlari BOSH harf bilan yoziladi.
Juft bo'lgan kiyimlar doim -s bilan keladi.
Ikki so'z birikib yangi ot yasaydi.
Ikki so'z birikib yangi ot yasaydi.
Boshlanish va yakun uchun tayyor shakllar.
Ikki oyoq yoki ikki qo'l uchun bo'lgani sababli -s bilan keladi.
Bu so'zlar hozir sodir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi.
Ma'nosi ko'plik bo'lsa ham, GRAMMATIK jihatdan BIRLIK.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the weather like (in + fasl/joy)? — It's + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the weather like in spring? — It's warm and sunny in spring.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bahorda ob-havo qanday bo'ladi? — Bahorda iliq va quyoshli bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bu — ob-havo haqidagi ASOSIY savol.
'like' bu yerda 'qanday?' degani, 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's cold, cloudy and windy. It's freezing cold and snowy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sovuq, bulutli va shamolli. Qattiq sovuq va qorli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir necha sifat: vergul bilan, oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.
Ega DOIM 'it' — ob-havo haqida boshqa ega ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is raining/snowing.  —  It's a rainy/snowy day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is raining. It's a rainy day.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir xil ma'noni ikki xil aytish:
  FE'L bilan (-ing) yoki SIFAT bilan (-y).

sentencePatterns.formula: The sun is shining. / The wind is blowing. / There is a lot of fog.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are clouds in the sky and the wind is blowing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Osmonda bulutlar bor va shamol esayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'sun', 'wind' — aniq ega bo'lgani uchun THE bilan.
'fog' sanalmaydi → 'a lot of fog' (ko'p tuman).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is wearing a pink dress. He is wearing a black cap.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U pushti ko'ylak kiygan. U qora kepka kiygan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are sitting on the beach under a sunshade. They are walking by the lake.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular plyajda soyabon ostida o'tirishibdi. Ular ko'l bo'yida ketishayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Present Continuous — rasmdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are making a snowman. It is snowing heavily.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qorbobo yasashayapti. Qor qalin yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish.
Vaqt so'zlari: now, at the moment, today.

sentencePatterns.formula: someone IS WEARING + kiyim  /  someone IS IN + kiyim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The children are wearing their heavy jackets. The children are in their pyjamas.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bolalar qalin kurtka kiyib olishgan. Bolalar pijamada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki qolip ham bir xil ma'noda.
'be in' qolipi qisqaroq va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar qalin kurtka kiyishgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular juda xursand, chunki archani bezashayapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'as' bu yerda 'because' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can't imagine HOW + sifat + IT IS.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysiz!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bilvosita gapda so'z tartibi ODDIY qoladi:
'how cold IT IS' — 'how cold IS IT' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ism + is in + shahar. It's + ob-havo + there.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom Varshavada. U yerda juda sovuq va qor yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'there' = u yerda — shahar nomini takrorlamaslik uchun.
